svg.title: Clarence's pipeline
svg.desc: One 4/4 bar through five stages, bar height showing rank. STRUCTURE ranks the four beats 3, 0, 2, 1. TUPLET turns beats 3 and 4 into a triplet. RATCHET splits the middle triplet slot into two hits. THINNING rests the lowest-ranked hit. EXPRESSION turns the slots into gates whose velocity and length follow rank. Dashed arrows from THINNING point to its three positions: before tuplets, after tuplets, after ratchets (default). ROTATION and RANDOM act across TUPLET to EXPRESSION.

path.aria-label: rotates tuplets, ratchets, rests and velocities
